title: Figure 14: Schematic of pulse compression in magnetized plasma
description: Horizontal schematic of a waveguide bounded by hatched "metal" walls, showing a radiation pulse (frequency ω0, length CT) entering a "plasma" region under magnetic field B(t), slowing to group velocity Vg0, then shifting to frequency ω1 and velocity Vg1 before emerging compressed. Caption: "Figure 14. Schematic of Pulse Compression in Magnetized Plasma." Appears under the section heading "Applications to Circuits and Waveguide Miniaturization: Slowing Down and Manipulating Electromagnetic Pulses (EMP) Using Advanced Metamaterials."
